question:
Select the pair which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

DBC−YWX

KIJ−FDE
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d236b4b3d54ba7cf8b860a93797f7e4d8e8c99ca9a5dd4d0f64ad1c6214315d8.png] 

Logic followed here is: (Positional value of each letter) - 5.

**DBC is coded as YWX →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d70c25f7bb1483c4e3fdfe2cc3e366a7e4fb1b9bf1418346ac79f78605b20fb8.png] 

**KIJ is coded as FDE →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c263f0c283a8185038dbeb92500f6fde1063ba1fe707394d67c432918d5acc5a.png] 

**Similarly, Option 1) RPQ:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45f37a0a28093f7a642eb9283de45b3ea057d900ac619686d9fbef21d07daf65.png] 

Therefore, the pair following the same pattern is RPQ - MKL.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
